title: Introducing Jackie Redmond: Get to Know WWE RAW's Newest Addition
htmlContent:
This week on Monday Night RAW, the WWE Universe was introduced to Jackie Redmond, who made her debut on the broadcast team. The Canadian sports broadcaster impressed both The American Nightmare Cody Rhodes and the crowd in Baltimore with her successful first appearance. However, since her RAW debut, many fans have been curious about who Jackie Redmond is.

Jackie Redmond is a well-known sports broadcaster, recognized for her passion for various sports. She is also an avid fitness enthusiast and a mental health advocate. While her debut on RAW marked her first appearance as a member of the WWE broadcast team, it is not her first involvement with WWE.

In 2021, Redmond joined WWE as the co-host of RAW Talk and Talking Smack, where she left a positive impression on many. Now, with this new responsibility on Monday Night RAW, fans are excited to see how she handles her expanded role. Judging by the crowd's reaction, it seems that the 36-year-old will do just fine.

Redmond's move to RAW is part of a broadcasting team shakeup recently announced by WWE. Cathy Kelly, who previously served on RAW, moved to SmackDown as a result. However, Redmond's duties extend beyond RAW. She will also join the live kick-off event panels, sitting alongside Kayla Braxton to host the pre-shows with Booker T and Peter Rosenberg. Redmond will also be responsible for studio work.

Another individual with an expanded role in this shakeup is Megan Morant. The 28-year-old will host RAW Talk, SmackDown LowDown, and several other digital shows for WWE. It will be interesting to see how each person adapts to their new roles within the broadcasting team.

Aside from her involvement with WWE, Redmond is known for her coverage of the NHL. As a host and anchor for Warner Bros. Discovery Sports, she passionately covers hockey. Her love for sports has garnered appreciation from fans on social media.

With her vast experience in sports broadcasting and her expanded role in WWE, Jackie Redmond has an exciting journey ahead on Monday Night RAW. As a dedicated sports enthusiast, she is poised to make a significant impact during her time with the company. Fans eagerly await her contributions to the wrestling world and her continued coverage of various sports.
